usedFor: TidyHQ holds your members and Zoho Books holds the accounts, so “Contact Activated” runs “Create or Update Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Activated” in TidyHQ, then “Create or Update Customer” in Zoho Books
bestTemplate.why: A new member becomes a Zoho Books customer, and an existing one is updated instead of duplicated.

watchOut: “Contact Merged” in TidyHQ fires when two contacts merge, so check which record “Create or Update Customer” should keep.
